Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Interactive Pet Species Showcase Screen: Insert a new species showcase screen before pick_friend featuring interactive 3D previews of pet animations and traits. (why: Adoption step drops nearly 40% of users and has high completion time; letting users preview animated pets early builds momentum.)
1: [home, redesign] Interactive Waiting Stage Playground: Redesign the waiting screen into an interactive preview playground where users can trigger sound effects and animations while background generation finishes. (why: The home waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean time of 2336s, causing significant drop-off before completion.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Interactive Guide Screen: Add an interactive controls overview screen right before home_intro displaying hotkey and desktop interaction checklists. (why: Support received multiple tickets about post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on desktop.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Personality & Trait Customization Flow: Replace simple pet choice cards with a multi-trait customization split view allowing personality and coat color selection. (why: Support reported 3 emails regarding custom pet generation errors and poor initial appearance choices during adoption.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Sync Warning & Persistent Account Hint: Add an explicit account sync hint and badge warning users that pet data is permanently tied to the signed-in account. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after users signed in again with a secondary account.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Overlay Compatibility Checklist on Finish: Add a display driver and overlay permission status checklist to home_intro to verify desktop readiness before launch. (why: Support received 3 emails where pets failed to display on screen or app failed to open after setup.)
